question: On R1's network wiring, do the DNs that drove a core oscillation in R3 reach E1, E2 and I1 differently from the DNs that did not, and on which side of that difference does DNg100_L fall?
not_claimed: that the control-DN oscillation is real or needs the core
anything about the live LIF engine
a change to motor admission or mappings
known_before: R2 listed DNg100_L's two-hop intermediates per core cell (129181 is one of E1's); DNg100_L reaches E1 in two hops. No control DN's routes, weights or degrees were computed or inspected.

sources.cache: maleCNS cache (load_cache verifies the canonical source fingerprints)
sources.hash_rule: text files: sha256 after CRLF -> LF; .bin/.flys and evidence result.json: sha256 of raw bytes

network: R1's 2,111-neuron front-left network and signed matrix W[post, pre] = transmitter sign x synapse count (count >= 5), dng100_rate_model.Model unchanged

groups.rule: RHYTHMIC = R1's control DNs with R3 result arms.R1SIZE.controls[k].score >= 0.5 (R3's C1 threshold; NaN is not >= 0.5); NONRHYTHMIC = the other controls; DNG100 = DNg100_L
groups.mismatch: if the rule does not return exactly expected_rhythmic, the run stops as INCONCLUSIVE

metrics.direct_c: W[c, s] for c in E1, E2, I1
metrics.twohop_c: sum_k W[c, k] W[k, s] over network k != s, c (net signed)
metrics.i1_share: excitatory two-hop drive into I1 / sum over E1, E2, I1; excitatory = both edges positive; k != s, k != target; NaN if 0
metrics.core_focus: excitatory two-hop drive into E1+E2+I1 / excitatory two-hop drive into all network cells except s; NaN if 0
metrics.out_degree: count of network cells j != s with W[j, s] != 0
metrics.direct_mn: sum W[m, s] over the 68 front-left MNs
metrics.core_hops: mean unweighted hop distance s -> E1, E2, I1 (R2 hops); inf if any unreachable

reported_not_gated: two-hop intermediates per core cell with body IDs and names; overlap among RHYTHMIC DNs and with DNg100_L
RHYTHMIC DNs that are DNg100_L intermediates
s_R1, s_VNC (R1b cord-only, as R2) and rho

acceptance.separation: exact two-sided permutation test of the RHYTHMIC mid-rank sum over all C(n, 3) assignments among the n non-NaN control values (n = 20 -> 1,140); separates if p <= 0.05/12; a metric with a NaN RHYTHMIC value does not separate
acceptance.placement: for a separating metric: nonrhythmic_side if DNg100_L's value is strictly outside the RHYTHMIC range toward the NONRHYTHMIC median; otherwise not; NaN -> not
acceptance.SIGNATURE_DNG100_DIFFERS: >= 1 separating metric with DNg100_L on the nonrhythmic side
acceptance.SIGNATURE_DNG100_LIKE_RHYTHMIC: >= 1 separating metric, DNg100_L not on the nonrhythmic side of any

integrity.I1: source hashes; R1 network body-ID hash; control list unchanged and in the network; group rule returns expected_rhythmic
integrity.I2: hard gate: DNg100_L's two-hop intermediates per core cell equal R2 result.json structure.intermediates_by_cell exactly
integrity.I3: tests/test_dng100_route_comparison.py passes (toy metrics, exact permutation test incl. ties and NaN, placement, verdict, group rule, expectations, completeness)
integrity.I4: 21 DNs x 12 metrics present; NaN only for i1_share/core_focus, inf only for core_hops

expectations.X3: DNg100_L i1_share > every RHYTHMIC DN's (None if any NaN)
expectations.note: recorded in the design before any R4 computation; wrong ones are recorded as wrong

plumbing_disclosure: Before registration one load check (--load-check) printed network size 2,111, 68 MNs, instances per neuron, controls in network and source hashes; no metric value was computed or printed. Unit tests use toy matrices only. One test expectation was corrected before any run (placement(0, [5,6,7], [1,1,2]) is nonrhythmic_side by the design's rule; the test had wrongly expected the opposite).
execution: one command (--output) computes and evaluates in the same process; output opened exclusively; run once.
interpretation_limits: Three RHYTHMIC DNs, from an unplanned R1SIZE-only R3 observation without core silencing.
Structure only: two-hop routes in R1's isolated network; longer routes and recurrent dynamics not captured.
Weights are signed synapse counts with R1's transmitter signs; no physiology.
Twelve chosen metrics; others could separate where these do not.
Wiring is identical in both size versions, so R4 cannot explain why the oscillation appeared only with R1's sizes.
No body or physics; motor coordinates unchanged (20/42 admitted, +4 conditional).
